academicServicesPage.subtitle: We support master's and PhD students, researchers, and authors with professional editing, formatting, and technical support services, while fully preserving academic integrity.
academicServicesPage.heroCta: Contact Us to Request a Service
academicServicesPage.servicesSectionSubtitle: A complete set of services designed to support researchers and authors at every stage of preparing their scholarly work

services.title: Thesis & Book Formatting
services.description: We help you present your work in an organized, professional format that eases reading and review while meeting academic requirements.

services.title: Technical Layout for Research & Publications
services.description: We elevate the final appearance of your scholarly work with a consistent layout that reflects its quality and prepares it for printing or publishing.

services.title: Language Proofreading & Editing
services.description: We improve the quality and soundness of your text by correcting language and spelling errors and refining style while preserving the scholarly meaning.

services.title: Indexing
services.description: We make your research content easier to access by preparing accurate, organized indexes for topics, verses, hadiths, names, and terminology.

services.title: Reference & Footnote Documentation
services.description: We strengthen the scholarly accuracy of your research by organizing sources, references, footnotes, and citations according to the required style.

services.title: Biographical Entries
services.description: We provide documented scholarly biographies for figures mentioned in the research or publication, completing the documentation and introducing those figures.

services.title: Hadith & Narration Referencing (Takhrij)
services.description: We strengthen the hadith-related documentation of your research by tracing hadiths and narrations to their sources, noting their locations, and stating their grading according to recognized scholarly sources.

strengths.title: Complete Confidentiality
strengths.description: We protect the privacy of your data and files throughout the entire process.

strengths.title: Scholarly Accuracy
strengths.description: We adhere to accuracy and scholarly methodology standards in every service we provide.

strengths.title: On-Time Delivery
strengths.description: We deliver our work by the agreed deadlines without delay.

strengths.title: Revisions Available
strengths.description: We offer reviews and revisions to the work as agreed with the client.

faq.q: How long does the service take?
faq.a: The duration varies depending on the size of the work and the type of service requested, and is determined precisely after reviewing the request and agreeing with the client.

faq.q: How can I send my files?
faq.a: You can send your files directly via WhatsApp after contacting us and specifying the required service.

faq.q: Do you write the research on behalf of the researcher?
faq.a: No, our services focus on technical support, editing, formatting, and documentation, while fully preserving academic integrity. We do not write research on behalf of the researcher.

faq.q: Can revisions be made after delivery?
faq.a: Yes, we offer the possibility of revisions after delivery as agreed upon in advance with the client.

faq.q: Are my data and files confidential?
faq.a: Yes, we are committed to maintaining the confidentiality of all files and data shared with us by clients.

faq.q: How long does it take to build an educational platform, website, or app?
faq.a: Timelines depend on project scope and features. Corporate websites and standard platforms typically take 2 to 4 weeks, while custom enterprise systems and mobile apps follow a detailed milestone schedule agreed upon during discovery.

faq.q: Can the platform be integrated with payment gateways and virtual classrooms?
faq.a: Yes. We integrate local and international payment methods (Vodafone Cash, InstaPay, Fawry, Visa/MasterCard) as well as Zoom, Google Meet, and WhatsApp notifications.

faq.q: Are educational videos and content protected against piracy?
faq.a: Absolutely. We implement encrypted video streaming, dynamic student watermarks, and multi-device session restrictions to protect your intellectual property.

faq.q: Will I get a full control panel to manage the platform or system?
faq.a: Yes. Every project includes an intuitive bilingual (Arabic/English) dashboard to manage content, students, instructors, sales, financial reports, and permissions without technical complexity.

faq.q: Do you provide technical support and maintenance after delivery?
faq.a: Yes, we provide a post-launch warranty and free technical support period along with full team training, plus optional ongoing maintenance and upgrade packages.

terms.title: Second: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: By using Rawasikh's website or services, you agree to abide by the following terms and conditions:

payment.title: Third: Payment and Refund Policy
pay: Course or service fees are paid through the company's approved payment methods.

No refunds are issued after the service has begun or content has been accessed, except in exceptional cases approved by company management.

disclaimer.title: Fourth: Legal Disclaimer

Copying, republishing, or distributing any content without prior written permission from the company is prohibited.

policiesPageTeacher.subtitle: Terms and obligations for instructors and trainers collaborating with Rawasikh

privacy.title: 1. Instructor Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Rawasikh is committed to protecting the personal and professional data of instructors who collaborate with it, and will not use it beyond the scope of the contractual relationship between both parties.
collect: Personal and professional data (name, contact details, CV, qualifications).
Bank account or approved payment method for disbursing dues.
Performance records and evaluations of lectures and courses.
use: Administrative and contractual coordination regarding courses and lectures.
Evaluate performance quality and improve the educational service.
privacy.protect: Rawasikh is committed to taking the necessary technical and organizational measures to protect instructors' data from any unauthorized access or use.
privacy.share: Rawasikh does not share instructors' data with any third party except as required by law, with the instructor's consent, or to fulfill contractual obligations.

terms.title: 2. Terms and Conditions for Instructors
terms.intro: By joining Rawasikh as an instructor or collaborating trainer, you agree to abide by the following:
items: Committing to the agreed schedule for delivering lectures or courses.
Maintaining the quality, integrity, and currency of the academic content.
Adhering to teaching ethics and professional conduct with students and management.
Not using the Rawasikh platform or its students' data for any purpose outside the agreed scope of collaboration.
Rawasikh reserves the right to terminate the collaboration in case of breach of any of these terms.

payment.title: 3. Compensation and Dues Policy
pay: Instructor dues are calculated according to the agreement between both parties (percentage, fixed amount, or per hour/student).
Dues are disbursed on the agreed dates after completing administrative review procedures.
refund: If a lecture is cancelled or postponed by the instructor without acceptable justification, Rawasikh reserves the right to review the related dues.
Any dispute regarding financial dues is resolved through direct communication with the finance department within a specified period.

disclaimer.title: 4. Legal Disclaimer
items: The instructor bears responsibility for the accuracy and correctness of the academic content they present.
Rawasikh bears no responsibility for any personal statements or opinions expressed by the instructor outside the scope of the approved educational content.
Rawasikh is committed to providing a suitable teaching environment, without guaranteeing specific educational outcomes for students.

ip.title: 5. Intellectual Property Rights
items: Educational materials prepared specifically for the Rawasikh platform (under a contractual agreement) are considered Rawasikh's intellectual property unless otherwise agreed in writing.
The instructor may use their general expertise and knowledge outside the scope of content prepared specifically for the platform.
Publishing or distributing any platform-specific educational content outside Rawasikh is prohibited without prior written permission.
Upon termination of the collaboration, Rawasikh retains full rights to the content prepared on its behalf.
